settings.title: Historical temperature inputs
settings.description: Temperature reports are read-only. Open Thermal Planner in the sidebar to run and review reports. Outdoor and recorded weather temperature are optional. To add a weather provider, use Settings → Devices & services → Add integration, then return here. No forecast or energy sensor is required. Freshness bounds how long a recorded state can be held; unchanged states older than this limit are conservatively unavailable.

room.title: {room_action}
room.description: Add one room at a time. Select its temperature sensor, then use the same picker again to add more sensors for this room. After submitting, you can add another room or save your configuration.

data_description.name: For example, Living room or Kitchen. Each room needs a different name.
data_description.sensors: One sensor is enough. Multiple sensors are averaged equally unless you change their weights under More room settings.
data_description.floor: Choose an existing Home Assistant floor, or leave empty. Rooms without a floor still get their own report.
data_description.comfort_min: Report when this room falls below this temperature. Ordinary reports do not control heating; development lab measurements are started separately.
data_description.zone: Both radiator and underfloor rooms may share this zone of the same heat pump.

data.constrains: Include in comfort planning and first-room-to-cool result
data.comfort_estimate: Show an advisory PMV/PPD comfort estimate

data_description.circuit: An optional label for rooms sharing a heating loop, for example Radiators or Underfloor loop. It does not configure valves or heating controls.
data_description.emitter: What heats this room: radiators, underfloor heating, a mixture, or another type.
data_description.relative_weights: Leave blank for an equal average. Otherwise enter one non-negative number per selected sensor, in order, separated by commas. At least one must be positive. For a primary sensor, use 1 for it and 0 for the others.
data_description.diagnostics: For example, a floor-surface or heating-pipe temperature sensor. These extra readings are saved with the report data for comparison; they do not affect the room average, floor average, or minimum-temperature check.
data_description.floor_weight: Default 1 gives each room an equal share. Use 2 for twice the share, or 0 to leave this room out of its floor average. Its own report and minimum-temperature check are kept. Has no effect without a floor.
data_description.constrains: Use this room’s comfort target when planning shared heating, and include it in the first-room-to-cool result. Its hard minimum always applies, even when this is off.
data_description.humidity: Optional % RH input with independent freshness/coverage. Missing humidity never removes air-temperature reports.
data_description.radiant_temperature: Use a true mean-radiant temperature measurement, not a single floor-surface or pipe temperature. Without one, air temperature is an explicitly labelled proxy.
data_description.comfort_estimate: Fanger PMV/PPD is an estimate under the selected clothing/activity/air-speed/radiant assumptions, not measured feels-like °C. Actual air temperature always drives guards and restoration.

menu_options.heat_source: Choose or configure the heat pump

remove_room.title: Choose a room to remove
remove_room.description: This changes future reports only. Existing reports keep their original room configuration. Choose Save configuration afterward to apply the removal.

heat_source.title: One heat pump
heat_source.description: Select the one central space-heating climate when available. A heat pump can serve multiple zones; radiators and underfloor heating are room types, not separate pumps or zones. Leaving the climate empty keeps reports available in observation mode. Setup sends no commands. Real-source control stays unavailable until you explicitly commission pause and restoration while on site.

data_description.climate: Select space heating, not a DHW-only controller. Central pauses affect the configured source; confirm what this action does to DHW, schedules and all zones before commissioning.

advanced.name: Telemetry, direct-flow trials and control bounds

data.direct_mode_confirmed: This setter controls a direct water-temperature target
data.commissioning_allowed: Allow a supervised commissioning run on this source
data.climate_target_is_flow: Climate target mirrors this water-flow target

data_description.commissioning_allowed: Only enable this when you can observe the installation and have checked the configured Heat/Off actions and restore behavior. Start commissioning separately on the Thermal Planner page; this checkbox itself issues no commands. Automatic planning is a separate later opt-in.
data_description.flow_setter: Optional HA number/input_number in °C. A readback, explicit safe limits, and direct-mode confirmation are required. Compensation curves are not edited.
data_description.disturbances: An on/open or missing configured indicator marks measurement intervals as contaminated for learning.
data_description.recovery_tolerance_c: Recovery means returning within this tolerance of starting air temperatures, while respecting each room minimum.

zones.title: Heat-pump zones

zone.title: Heat-pump zone
zone.description: A distribution zone belongs to the same heat pump. Several radiator and UFH rooms can share one zone. Optional zone climate and water/pump entities provide context; only the central source climate is commanded. Assign rooms to zones in their room forms when more than one zone exists.

remove_zone.title: Choose an unused zone to remove

energy.title: Optional heat-pump energy inputs
energy.description: Electrical input and delivered thermal output are independent and optional. Confirm units and scope for each. A heat-pump total including DHW is not labelled as space-heating energy. COP requires matched, positive, sufficiently covered channels.

campaign_settings.title: Bounded measurement campaign
campaign_settings.description: Schedule cooldown/recovery measurements in the Home Assistant time zone. Unsafe/busy/missed nights are skipped with a reason. Ambiguous or nonexistent DST start times are skipped. Configure bounds here, save, then explicitly start the campaign on the Thermal Planner page.

data.report_windows: Report boundaries in minutes (multiples of 5, beginning with 0)
data.drop_thresholds: Additional temperature drops to report (°C, comma-separated)

comfort_schedule.title: Comfort time blocks
comfort_schedule.description:
{blocks}

Targets apply to the whole shared-source plan; this does not imply room valves. Overnight blocks use the selected start weekday. Outside blocks, the room minimum applies. Rooms without blocks use their configured comfort target.

error.invalid_units: Select a temperature sensor with °C, °F or K units.
error.invalid_room: Use a unique room name and at least one available temperature sensor. Sensor weights must be non-negative, match the selected sensors, and include at least one positive value.
error.invalid_window: Select a past window of 1 minute to 24 hours. Ambiguous/skipped DST times require the replay action with explicit offsets.
error.replay_failed: Replay failed. Check Recorder availability and try again.
error.invalid_heat_source: Check climate Heat/Off capability, °C direct-flow setter/readback and explicit flow/control limits.
error.invalid_zone: Use a unique zone name and supported temperature units.
error.zone_in_use: Keep at least one zone. Reassign its rooms before removing it.
error.invalid_energy: Choose W/kW power or Wh/kWh counters matching the selected sensor, and confirm scope.
error.invalid_campaign: Check local time, date, source pause limit, increasing five-minute report boundaries and positive drop thresholds.
error.invalid_comfort_block: Choose a room, one or more weekdays and valid target times.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Thermal Planner configuration is needed.

init.title: Thermal Planner
init.description: Manage your rooms and temperature inputs here. For analysis and saved reports, open [Thermal Planner in the sidebar](/thermal-planner). Changes take effect after Save configuration. Existing reports keep their original settings.

menu_options.rooms: Manage rooms — add, edit or remove

remove_room.title: Choose a room to remove
remove_room.description: This changes future reports only. Existing reports keep their original room configuration. Choose Save configuration afterward to apply the removal.

replay.title: Replay historical window
replay.description: Select a past window from 1 minute to 24 hours in your Home Assistant time zone. Ambiguous or skipped DST times are rejected; use the replay action with explicit offsets for those times. No heating commands are sent.
